prerequisites: GRAPHIC EXPRESSION AND COMPUTER-AIDED DESIGN II/20224002

learning_outcomes.text: Applies drawing methods in the scaled system.
Applies topographic techniques to field problems.

syllabus_topics: 1.1 Levelling of industrial and electrical machinery
1.2 Levelling of steel and concrete structures.
2.3 Obtaining coordinates of inaccessible points for safety certification in electrical installations, etc.
3.1 Graphic representation of field data in 3D for obtaining digital terrain models.
3.2 Georeferencing projects using GPS or GIS systems.
4.1 Geodetic study for the transformation of field data to the universal UTM system.
4.2 Study of old cartography for the certification of capacity files, boundaries, cadastre, etc.
4.3 Study of GIS, ICGC and Cadastre pages.
T6. SETTING OUT IN THE FIELD
6.1 Setting out a projected industrial complex in the field.
assessment_rules: Assignments or practicals, whether group or individual, account for 70% of the final grade and must be submitted, only averaging if graded 4 or higher. The remaining 30% comes from practical tests (two partial tests of 15% each). A final exam is available for students who did not pass the partial tests or opted out of continuous assessment, counting for 100% in such cases.
bibliography: Gilberto Enríquez Harper, Trazado de Líneas Elécticas
Antonio Miguel González Cabezas, Lecciones de topografía y replanteos
José Mª Gentil Baldrich, Método y aplicación de representación acotada y del terreno
